hero.title: Community AI agents
hero.lead: An agent is software that can send transactions from a shared wallet — only within rules your community sets and approves.

how.title: How it works
how.body: The community funds a shared smart-wallet. An AI agent proposes payouts — for grants, tools, or services. Every spend must fit daily and weekly caps and an allow-list of recipients. Token holders can change the rules by vote. Nothing happens in secret: each action has a hash you can open in the explorer.

items.title: Hard caps
items.text: Per transaction, per day, and per week — so a bug or prompt cannot drain the treasury.

items.title: Allow-list
items.text: Money only goes to addresses the community already approved.

items.title: Governor vote
items.text: Changing caps, the allow-list, or the agent itself requires an on-chain token vote.

items.title: Emergency freeze
items.text: Guardians chosen by the community can pause spending while people investigate.

items.title: Public by default
items.text: Balances, votes, and payouts are visible like any other wallet — no hidden admin keys on our servers.

items.title: Open metrics
items.text: We plan to publish how we count an “active agent” (for example, a wallet with at least one outgoing transaction per day) so anyone can reproduce the numbers.

items.title: Not a memecoin launcher
items.text: Agents are for real community work — not for spinning up joke tokens.
